title: Example 2-2: Publishing Statement for Authorized User

illustrates.quote: a. Publisher Information. Depending upon whether or not copyright clearance has been obtained through an agency, the title page includes one of the following: (1) When authorized by copyright law, the title page states “Published by” followed by the publisher information.
